svg.title: Nguyen Family · Emotional Process
svg.desc: Minh and Lan are the parents of Anh, Bao and index person Chi; Anh and David are the parents of Oliver. Smooth emotional arcs show Minh–Anh cutoff labelled Estranged, Lan–Chi three-line fusion labelled Over-involved, Minh–Bao conflict, Bao–Chi distance and Anh–Oliver closeness.
